docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer position on Tessel Cargo Software's Routing & Tracking team. The role's focus on reliable event ingestion and a customer-facing tracking API connects closely with the backend work I have done on partner APIs and event-driven services.

At Tejo Insurance Tech, I designed a versioned OpenAPI 3 REST API for insurance brokers. Twelve partners were onboarded, and the API handles around 400,000 quote requests per month. I also addressed duplicate claim records caused by at-least-once Kafka delivery by implementing a transactional outbox and idempotency keys; duplicate claims fell from around 40 per week to zero over the following quarter. These projects have given me practical experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka, API design and service reliability.

My production service experience is in Java and Kotlin rather than Python; my Python use to date has been scripts for data fixes and small Jenkins helpers. I am interested in moving into a Python-focused backend role and would bring experience building backend services, automated tests, and Docker-based services, as well as using Kubernetes on EKS and AWS S3 and SQS as a service user.

I also take part in an on-call rota one week per month. In March 2024, I handled a major Kafka lag incident, and the incident write-up was praised. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience with event-driven systems and production operations could contribute to Tessel's shipment tracking platform.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
